items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are not evidenced. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Risk severity is high for public launch and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates and permit only bounded reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, data-handling, claims, and attribution boundaries. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only; do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct external outreach.
